desc:
🏍️ NEW: Sand Dunes! ride your builds in the new dunes expansion!

Build your own dirt bikes, sell them and keep the best to ride yourself, Can you grow a motorbike empire?

🚚 Order crates of parts and watch the truck back up to your loading dock
🔧 Bolt every part onto the bike yourself, then fire it up
🎨 Spray it any colour in your paint booth
💰 Put it on show and sell it to customers who ride it away
👷 Hire staff to run every station for you
🏢 Grow your workshop: a basement, an upper floor, more docks and racks
🛣️ Ride your bikes round the Metro Loop highway through the traffic
🤸 Pull wheelies and tricks, and hit the jumps on the MX track
⚙️ Tune your engine, turbo and exhaust at the Pit Lane tuning garage
🏆 Rebirth to unlock superbikes, mopeds and ATVs

Every bike in your garage is one you built yourself. Can you build the biggest bike empire?
